description:
## Finding
\`pkix-path/Cargo.toml\` (v0.2.0) line 21 and 33 contain comments that say:
- L21–22: \"v0.1: only RSA-PKCS1v15-SHA-256 and ECDSA-P-256-SHA-256 are implemented. p384 and ed25519 are reserved for v0.2 and are not declared as features here.\"
- L33: \"# Algorithm backends (optional; p384 and ed25519-dalek reserved for v0.2)\"

The package is v0.2.0; these comments are stale.

## Why P1
Section 0 anchor — the manifest claims about feature scope must match reality. A reader (or auditor, or Cargo doc generator) sees \"reserved for v0.2\" in v0.2.0 and reasonably expects p384/ed25519 support. Neither is implemented anywhere in the workspace; the comments are misleading and they entrench a forward-looking promise that is now overdue.

## Fix
Either:
- Remove the \"reserved for v0.2\" comments since they no longer describe the future, OR
- Update them to a concrete plan (\"reserved for v0.3\" with a tracking issue), OR
- Implement P-384 and Ed25519 support if v0.2 was the implementation target.

## Scope reference
\`pkix-path/Cargo.toml:21-22,33\`.
title: P1: pkix-path/Cargo.toml comments reference v0.1 features in v0.2.0 package
